const topic = $json.trendingTopic; const context = $json.context || ''; const sourceContent = $json.sourceContent || ''; const catLines = $json._catList.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean); const topicClean = topic.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]/g,' ').trim(); const prompt = `You are a professional food writer and recipe blogger for justcookdaily.com. Your task is to write a COMPLETELY ORIGINAL, SEO-optimized cooking article in English. INSPIRATION TOPIC: "${topic}" ${context ? `BRIEF CONTEXT: "${context.substring(0,500)}"` : ''} ${sourceContent ? `REFERENCE (for inspiration ONLY — DO NOT COPY): "${sourceContent.substring(0,1200)}"` : ''} CRITICAL RULES: - Write a 100% ORIGINAL article — do NOT copy any text from the reference. - Create YOUR OWN unique title, your own angle, your own structure. - English only. Warm, friendly, conversational food blog tone. - Target length: 1200 to 1500 words TOTAL for maximum SEO value. - NO H1 tag. NO promotional text. NO filler. NO placeholders like [content]. - Include REAL cooking tips, detailed ingredient science, technique explanations. - Each H2 section: 3-4 solid paragraphs. Make it feel human-written and authoritative. - Write for AdSense — safe, informative, family-friendly food content. - Add personal touches like 'I love adding...' or 'One trick I have discovered...' - Include specific measurements, temperatures, and timing. OUTPUT — write EXACTLY this structure: TITLE: [YOUR OWN unique long-tail SEO title, 8-12 words — DIFFERENT from the source] CATEGORY: [Single best number from: ${catLines.join(' | ')}] SLUG: [seo-friendly-slug-max-60-chars] META: [SEO meta description 130-155 chars] TAGS: [tag1],[tag2],[tag3],[tag4],[tag5],[tag6] EXCERPT: [2 compelling sentences] QUERY1: [Pexels search: beautiful finished plate of this dish, specific and descriptive] QUERY2: [Pexels search: fresh raw ingredients for this dish on wooden cutting board] QUERY3: [Pexels search: close-up cooking process action shot for this dish] ===START===

[Strong opening hook — personal anecdote or surprising fact about this dish]

What Makes This Dish So Special

[3-4 paragraphs: history, flavor profile, why people love it]

Ingredients You Will Need

[Detailed ingredient list with explanations for each, quantities, alternatives]

Step-by-Step Instructions

[intro paragraph]

  1. Step 1: [detailed instruction with temperature/time]
  2. Step 2: [detailed instruction]
  3. Step 3: [detailed instruction]
  4. Step 4: [detailed instruction]
  5. Step 5: [detailed instruction]
  6. Step 6: [detailed instruction]

Pro Tips for Perfect Results

[Expert tips with the science of why they work]

  • Tip 1: [specific advice]
  • Tip 2: [specific advice]
  • Tip 3: [specific advice]

Variations and Substitutions

[At least 3-4 creative variations with details]

Frequently Asked Questions

[Specific question about this dish]

[Detailed answer]

[Question about storage or meal prep]

[Detailed answer]

[Question about dietary adaptations]

[Detailed answer]

Final Thoughts

[Warm personal closing, encourage reader to try it]

===END=== REMINDER: Write REAL content in every section. No placeholders. 1200-1500 words minimum.`; return [{ json: { ...$json, _geminiBody: { contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }], generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: 8192, temperature: 0.75 } } } }];
